newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soy and corn basis values were mostly steady on Tuesday in subdued dealings, grain dealers said.
Hard red winter wheat offers were flat to lower.
In export news, Pakistan bought 450,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat over the long holiday weekend.
The HRW crop was in mostly good shape, but U.S. agronomists warned on Tuesday that current unseasonably warm weather could open the crop to problems later this spring.
